NiceGlow 6 Inch Glow Stick – Long Lasting Party, Festival & Event Light Sticks for Kids & Adults (Assorted Colors: Green, Red, Blue, Pink, Orange, Yellow)
Light up any occasion with NiceGlow 6 Inch Glow Sticks — the ultimate accessory for parties, festivals, concerts, camping, and celebrations. Available in six vibrant colors (Green, Red, Blue, Pink, Orange, Yellow), these glow sticks provide hours of radiant fun once activated. Simply bend and shake to enjoy a bright and colorful glow.
Crafted for durability and safety, they are suitable for both kids (5+) and adults. Whether it’s birthdays, weddings, discos, Halloween, New Year’s parties, outdoor events, or even emergency lighting, these glow sticks create the perfect atmosphere. Compact, portable, and easy to use, NiceGlow Glow Sticks are a must-have for your next celebration.
Key Features:


 	
Bright & vibrant colors: Green, Red, Blue, Pink, Orange & Yellow

 	
Long-lasting glow for hours of fun

 	
Easy activation — just bend and shake

 	
Safe and durable design for kids (5+) & adults

 	
Perfect for parties, festivals, concerts & events

 	
Great for camping, night walks & emergency use
